title: Amazon started life under a different name: Cadabra.
description:
Amazon started life under a different name: Cadabra. It was incorporated as Cadabra, Inc. on 5 July 1994.

The name was a twist on the magic word Abracadabra. That is how HISTORY describes it.

Founder who started the company in a rented garage in Bellevue, Washington.

Amazon was chosen partly because it starts with A. A name near the start of the alphabet would appear sooner in online searches, and the Amazon is the biggest river in the world.

The website opened as a bookshop on 16 July 1995. It billed itself as the world’s largest collection of books for anyone with web access.

The shop opened a year and eleven days after the company was founded.
